#1. DMR finding, DMRCata
```{r}
DMR_PT.NT <- champ.DMR(beta=beta %>% as.data.frame(),
              pheno=ph$Sample.Type,
              compare.group=NULL,
              arraytype="450K",
              method = "DMRcate",
              minProbes=7,
              adjPvalDmr=0.05,
              cores=2,
              rmSNPCH=T,
              fdr=0.05,
              dist=2,
              mafcut=0.05,
              lambda=1000,
              C=2)
gc()
```
